assessment.reason: A moderate model-over-price gap at plus money that survives the downside sensitivity check. It is correlated with the Suzuki points over, not a separate confirmation.
assessment.model_case: The projected mean is about 0.82 assists against a 0.5 line on roughly 19.7 projected minutes. Shrunk long-run rates may overstate output if his current linemates are weaker. The low sensitivity case still clears break-even.
assessment.price_case: The main 0.5 line at +115 needs a win rate a bit under one in two. Model fair odds are near -127. Only one other book is quoted, and blending toward market leaves a thin cushion.
assessment.context_case: Montréal has multiple forwards listed out. That could lower his linemates' finishing or concentrate power-play touches on him. Suzuki's own status, line and power-play role are unverified, and settlement rules are assumed, not checked.

qualitative_review.countercase: The book may be pricing a depleted Montréal attack that the long-run rate does not capture. Weaker finishing teammates directly reduce assist conversion. A near-even opposing goalie split adds noise, and one comparison book is thin evidence that +115 is mispriced.
